info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Trading Workbench API
info.description: The E-Trading Workbench API facilitates the management and enhancement of online trading activities for financial investments. This API enables users to update specific features and parameters of their trading workbench, allowing for tailored trading experiences. Primarily aimed at traders and financial institutions, it provides critical functionality to modify active trading sessions, optimize investments, and manage user preferences. By integrating this API, businesses can improve trading strategies and automate their investment workflows.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update a specific e-trading workbench resource identified by RES-100045, enabling the modification of its attributes and settings as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to partially update an existing resource in the e-trading workbench. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields to modify the investment management system as required.
